claim: For MariaDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS automatically stripes SSD storage of 400–65,536 GiB across 4 volumes.
question: At what storage size does RDS stripe MySQL or PostgreSQL storage across several volumes, and how many?

qualifiers.scope: per DB instance (General Purpose or Provisioned IOPS SSD; MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
qualifiers.condition: Oracle stripes from 200 GiB; SQL Server always uses 1 volume
